name: INRIA Aerial Image Labeling Dataset
source: INRIA (Institut National de Recherche en Informatique et en Automatique)
geography: Austria (Vienna, Innsbruck) + USA (Austin, Chicago, Kitsap County, West Tyrol, Bellingham). NOT India.
crs: Varies by city (local projected CRS); provided in dataset metadata
labels: Binary building / non-building pixel masks (raster). High quality, manually annotated.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Free for research including commercial.
provenance: Direct download from INRIA project page. No registration required.
limitations: NOT Indian data. NOT cadastral. Western European and US urban morphology differs significantly from Indian cities (denser fabric, different roof types, mixed-use). Use for pre-training only — do not use as Indian building extraction ground truth. Must validate domain gap before deployment.
intended_use: Task 1 (building extraction — pre-training benchmark; domain gap must be assessed)
